answer: A forged identity cluster forms an isolated island with no inbound trust edges, so its influence stays a thin plume rather than a flood. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and rewards flow only through a verified inlet of work history. Attackers must fund every fake identity with real collateral, making mass forgery cost more than the rewards it could capture. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
